criteria.description: POST /dealers with an email already in use returns 409
GET /dealers (Admin) returns the list of dealers, each with region and status visible
GET /dealers/:id returns 404 for a non-existent id
PATCH /dealers/:id/status (Admin) toggles a dealer between ACTIVE and SUSPENDED
POST /auth/login for a DEALER user linked to a SUSPENDED dealer returns 401 even with correct credentials
POST /auth/login for a DEALER user linked to an ACTIVE dealer still succeeds
POST /auth/refresh also rejects with 401 when the caller's linked dealer has since become SUSPENDED, even with a still-valid refresh cookie
All /dealers routes reject an unauthenticated caller with 401 and a non-Admin (Dealer-role) caller with 403
Frontend dealer list page renders dealers with region/status, submitting the New Dealer form calls createDealer and refreshes the list, and AdminShell routes /admin/dealers to this page
